# Salesforce Investment Memo

## Executive Summary
Salesforce should be evaluated from its CRM software position, subscription model, reported quarterly revenue, and competition risk. [claim_1] [claim_2] [claim_3] [claim_5]

## Business Overview
Salesforce describes itself as a customer relationship management software provider. [claim_1]

## Market / Industry Context
Customer data integration is a demand theme in the CRM market overview. [claim_4]

## Business Model
Subscription and support revenue is a major category for Salesforce. [claim_2]

## Financial and Operating Profile
Salesforce reported quarterly revenue of 9.9 billion dollars in the fixture results source. [claim_3]

## Competitive Landscape
Competition should be treated as a diligence area because Salesforce identifies competitive markets as a risk. [claim_5]

## Growth Drivers
Customer data integration is a possible demand driver, but valuation impact remains an open diligence item. [claim_4]

## Risks
Competition is a cited risk in the annual report. [claim_5]

## Open Diligence Questions
- What valuation assumptions are implied by current growth expectations?
- How durable are subscription growth and renewal trends beyond the reported quarter? [claim_3]
